title: memory_proposals
description: What the extraction prompt is permitted to return. The model supplies a category, a value, a confidence and a quotation -- and nothing else. Identifiers, timestamps, provenance and status are decided by the application, so there is no field here for the model to put them in (ADR-058).

proposals.description: Candidate facts. An empty array is a correct answer: most conversations contain nothing worth remembering.

category.description: The closed set from DOMAIN_MODEL section 5.9. Closed because categories are what a user filters and eventually auto-approves by.

value.description: The fact itself, one short sentence. Bounded because it goes into later prompts, where length is a budget everything else competes for.

confidence.description: Self-reported, and poorly calibrated (AI_MODELS section 15). Used as a coarse filter and nothing more. Bounded here so that a value outside the range is caught as a malformed answer rather than compared against a threshold as though it meant something.

evidence.description: The verbatim text this was read from. Required, never optional: the only way to check an extraction without re-running it is to read what it was based on. The application additionally checks that this text actually appears in the conversation.
